item.title: Arkansans traveling in the Middle East evacuate amid strikes in Iran
item.description: A group of tourists traveling in Israel were able to evacuate the country amid strikes on Iran and tensions ratcheting up in the region.

item.title: Pine Bluff city crews clean up former homeless encampment
item.description: On the corner of Flipper Avenue in the Dollarway neighborhood, Pine Bluff code enforcement believes around four members of the homeless population set up a camp that began to accumulate large amounts of trash.

item.title: Voters react after 2026 primary election for Lonoke County Sheriff
item.description: Republican candidate Aaron Spencer won the primary for Lonoke County Sheriff on Tuesday, defeating incumbent Sheriff John Staley and candidate David Bufford. Spencer will now face Democratic candidate Brian Mitchell in the November general election.

item.title: Statue honoring Nolan Richardson to be built at Bud Walton Arena
item.description: Legendary Arkansas basketball coach Nolan Richardson will soon be a permanent sight at Bud Walton Arena.

item.title: Run-off set in Jefferson County judge race after crowded Democratic primary
item.description: A Democratic primary run-off will be set for Jefferson County as the five-man race for county judge left constituents with no candidate securing the majority needed to win outright.

item.title: Maumelle voters approve bond measures for safety & recreation improvements
item.description: Maumelle residents may have noticed several bond measures on their ballots Tuesday night; all but one were approved, and officials say they could bring significant improvements to the city.

item.title: Former Razorback head football coach Lou Holtz dies at 89
item.description: Former Arkansas head football coach Lou Holtz has died, according to Notre Dame Athletics. Holtz was 89 years old.

item.title: Murder suspect Aaron Spencer wins Republican primary for Lonoke County sheriff race
item.description: Aaron Spencer won the Republican primary for Lonoke County sheriff, receiving 5,400 votes, and will face Democrat Brian Mitchell Sr. in the November general election, although Spencer is currently awaiting trial on a second-degree murder charge.

item.title: Sheriff releases details in death of mother and two children in Sebastian County
item.description: The Sebastian County Sheriff's Office has determined that Charity Beallis died of suicide and her two children died of homicide, and that her estranged husband was not near her home at the time of the incident.
